## Why visit

A compact Hydes pub that earns its place through regional beer and a sociable, straightforward pub atmosphere. The former cottages and single-room layout make a neat companion to the nearby Circus Tavern. For well-travelled beer drinkers, the useful experiment is a local bitter or mild rather than another internationally familiar IPA. It is also an efficient city-centre opportunity to investigate Hydes without making a suburban journey. Space is limited, so allow the visit to be brief if a match-day crowd has already filled it.

## Beer

Hydes Original and Dark Ruby mild are listed as regular cask beers, with additional Hydes choices.
